invariants.text: Category.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Category.name must be unique
Category.monthly_budget must be nullable (can be None)
Category.icon must be nullable (can be None)
Expense.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Expense.amount_cents must be a non-negative integer
Expense.description must be a non-null string
Expense.expense_date must be a non-null ISO date string
Expense.category_id must reference an existing Category (exists in Category.id)
Expense.payment_method must be one of ['cash', 'card', 'transfer']
Expense.is_recurring must be a boolean
Budget.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Budget.category_id must reference an existing Category (exists in Category.id)
Budget.month must be a string in format 'YYYY-MM'
Budget.amount_limit_cents must be a non-negative integer
Budget.category_id and month must be unique across all budgets (UNIQUE constraint on (category_id, month))
Expense.amount_cents + all other expenses in the same category for the same month must not exceed Budget.amount_limit_cents if a budget exists for that category and month
Expense.expense_date must be in the past or present (not a future date)
Expense.is_recurring must be false if expense_date is in the future
Expense.category_id must be provided if expense_date is in the current month or later
